entityDescription:
QRCL Technologies OÜ — Post-Quantum Space & Critical Infrastructure Security

QRCL Technologies OÜ (Estonia) develops quantum-resistant cryptographic systems for satellite operations, aerospace coordination, and critical infrastructure. Our core innovation addresses the EU quantum-safe migration imperative outlined in NIS2, DORA, and emerging space-sector standards (ESA CCSDS, ECSS-E-80-3-520 spacecraft security).

EU Regulatory Alignment: 
- DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act): Cryptographic agility framework for authorized parties 
- NIS2 (Network & Information Security Directive 2): Quantum-risk mitigation for essential services (energy, transportation, communications) 
- MiCA / PSD2: Post-quantum digital signatures for financial settlement finality 
- AI Act: Explainable Byzantine consensus for space-segment AI/ML operations 
- CRA (Cyber Resilience Act): ML-DSA-65 / ML-KEM-768 / SLH-DSA-SHAKE-192f (FIPS 204/203/205)

Technical Pillars: 
1. QRCL-GUARD — GNSS integrity (dual-frequency correction, Kalman fusion, BFT arbitration) 
2. QRCL-COSMOS — Orbital-mechanics decisioning (CCSDS-compliant telemetry, audit-chain commitment) 
3. QRCL-DEBRIS — Conjunction-alert coordination (6-of-7 Byzantine validator, 40 ms latency SLA) 
4. QRCL-QKD — FIPS 203 key establishment with BB84 simulation & privacy amplification 
5. QRCL-QNET — Entanglement-link coordination (Quantum Internet Alliance compliance) 
6. QRCL-ATM — Air-traffic & drone coordination (EASA TCAS II / airspace-risk integration)

entityDescription:
Duisburger Hafen AG (duisport) operates the largest inland port in the world. As a trimodal logistics hub, duisport is one of Europe’s key nodes for the flow of goods. Each year, more than 20,000 ships and 25,000 trains are handled in Duisburg, with over 100 million tons of cargo and around four million containers (TEU) moved through the port. The Port of Duisburg comprises 21 port basins, 10 container terminals, and approximately 200 kilometers of its own rail network.
Around 300 transport and logistics companies are located at the site, with approximately 52,000 jobs directly or indirectly dependent on the port and logistics sector.
The duisport Group combines a strategic geographic location and ideal site conditions with extensive logistics expertise. It provides customers from around the world with end-to-end solutions for the development and optimization of global supply chains – across real estate, rail freight, industrial logistics, contract logistics, and packaging logistics

entityDescription:
Blockchain & Cie. is a French EURL (Entreprise Unipersonnelle à Responsabilité Limitée) specialised in AI-agentic engineering, Web3/blockchain development, and production-hardened software for regulated industries.
Founded and operated by Antoine Delamare (PharmD, RS5000-certified blockchain developer, and full-stack lead developer), the company bridges clinical/regulatory judgment with modern software delivery.

Core competences:
- AI-generated code rescue: audit, stabilisation, and security hardening of AI-assisted/vibecoded repositories (TypeScript, Node.js, React/Next.js, Python/FastAPI).
- Production AI agents: deployment of autonomous agent stacks in hardened Docker environments, using multi-LLM routing, MCP, WhatsApp/Matrix bridges, and human-in-the-loop guardrails.
- Web3 & traceability: Solidity smart contracts, OpenZeppelin standards, Chainlink oracle integration, and traceability systems for EUDR/CSDDD, DSCSA/FMD, and supply-chain compliance.
- Geospatial & data interfaces: interactive mapping, GeoJSON field capture, role-based dashboards, and multi-language onboarding flows.

Relevant experience:
- ESA OCTAVE / Parametry UG: full-stack system engineer on an ESA-funded, EU-regulated traceability project for organic cotton, delivering a React geospatial mapper, Solidity SBT/ERC-1155 certificates, Chainlink Functions oracle, and a WhatsApp farmer-onboarding AI agent (Nanobot).
- Celestical Cloud : delivery and hardening of 6+ Docker-based AI agent stacks (Nanobot, Hermes) with multi-LLM, MCP, and multi-channel integration (Telegram, Whatsapp, etc.).
- Compositex (materials and technical textiles manufacturing company) : repo rescue and improvements of a production ERP (security patch, dependency vendoring, QA tests, architecture documentation, new features, etc.)

Blockchain & Cie operates full-remote from UTC-3 with daily overlap with EU and US East Coast timezones.

We work in French, English, and Spanish.

We are interested in teaming, subcontracting, and consortium partnerships for ESA, EU, and national space/health/AI programmes requiring reliable agentic systems, blockchain traceability, or regulated software engineering.

entityDescription:
Qalio Quantum Computing is a established Spanish startup, specializing in quantum algorithms for space applications. The company focuses on solving complex optimization challenges in the space sector. Qalio bridges the gap between theoretical quantum computing research and practical space mission requirements, delivering hybrid quantum-classical solutions optimized for near-term hardware.
The company's flagship platform, Phoeqiss, emerged directly from this research, providing a comprehensive environment for designing, simulating, and benchmarking quantum optimization algorithms. Phoeqiss enables rapid prototyping of mission-specific quantum oracles, visualization of superposition-based search processes, and direct comparison against classical baselines—critical capabilities for demonstrating operational value to ESA

entityDescription:
Energy@Work is an innovative Italian research-driven SME, established as a cooperative and headquartered in Triggiano (Bari, Apulia, Italy). The company develops advanced digital technologies that support the digital and sustainable transformation of regional ecosystems and industrial value chains, with a people-centred approach and a strong commitment to concrete technology transfer from research to deployment.
The company operates at the intersection of applied research, software engineering and system integration. Its core activity is the design, development and operational deployment of digital platforms, data-driven services and interoperable middleware solutions for complex socio-technical systems, with particular attention to data interoperability, real-time data acquisition, AI-based analytics, decision-support and edge/cloud architectures. Energy@Work is consistently ranked among the top-100 Italian SMEs for participation in competitive research grants, and among the top-10 SMEs in Southern Italy by the same indicator.Throughout its history Energy@Work has participated in several EU-funded research and innovation projects under H2020 and Horizon Europe and has built a stable network of long-term collaborations with European research and technology organisations, universities, industrial partners, public authorities and end-user communities, and contributes to several European clusters and policy-oriented initiatives. Beyond R&D activities, Energy@Work delivers professional services to industrial, institutional and public-sector clients, with a structured methodology covering requirements engineering, system architecture, software development, integration, validation and after-deployment support. The company invests systematically in the professional growth of its staff, in the consolidation of its internal know-how and in the responsible adoption of emerging technologies, with the long-term objective of being a reliable European technology partner for digital transformation and sustainable innovation.
E@W competences also include the design and management of sensor networks, the continuous monitoring of metrics and consumption, and the integration of heterogeneous field data sources, ranging from local and wide-area network buses (LAN/MAN/WAN) to satellite-based geolocation services such as Copernicus, Galileo and EGNOS, which can be exploited for the tracking and management of distributed assets. E@W also works on semantic schemas and information models for interoperability, supporting sectorial dataspaces and cross-domain data exchange across federated platforms, as well as on the secure and decentralized sharing of data through distributed ledger technologies (eg. HLF) combined with standardized data-space connectors such as IDS-RAM. E@W also has competences in the design and development of AI-based Digital Twins that integrate process, asset and human-related data to enable real-time monitoring, "what-if" simulations and explainable decision support, with built-in privacy-preserving mechanisms.

description: ODES is an Athens-based deep-tech company delivering a flight-proven simulation and validation platform for space missions, aimed at the NewSpace and institutional markets. A spin-off of EMTECH SPACE S.A., ODES provides both software tools and engineering services that support the complete mission lifecycle — from proposal and mission-analysis budgets, through subsystem engineering and pre-launch verification, to operations rehearsal and in-orbit support via digital-twin technology. Its core products cover pre-launch platform verification, mission operations rehearsal and RF spectrum coordination and interference analysis (against Live ITU filings). ODES tools have already been applied on multiple real space missions, helping operators cut time-to-launch and cost while raising mission assurance and regulatory compliance.
entityDescription:
ODES Space P.C. is a New Space software company developing simulation and validation technology for the satellite mission lifecycle. Its SaaS platform is built around a "living digital twin" — a high-fidelity model of the spacecraft and mission that evolves from early design through integration, launch, and in-orbit operations. It enables mission teams to simulate spacecraft behaviour, validate flight procedures and software, verify subsystem performance, and de-risk operational decisions before and during flight.
Targeting microsatellite and CubeSat missions, where affordable high-fidelity simulation is scarce, ODES unifies design-phase modelling with operational simulation in one continuous environment to reduce mission risk, shorten validation cycles, and improve operational readiness. The company combines expertise in spacecraft systems engineering, simulation (ECSS-SMP/SIMULUS-class), ground segment and mission operations.

The Center of Automotive Management (CAM) was founded by Prof. Stefan Bratzel in 2004 with the support of the University of Applied Sciences of Bergisch Gladbach. Its function is to serve as a partner for car manufacturers, suppliers and retailers concerning market research and strategic consultancy. Currently the CAM consists of a regular staff of five team members and is located in the town of Bergisch Gladbach near Cologne. 
Shortly after its foundation the CAM established two separate approaches to analyse and determine the competitiveness of the global automotive industry. The first approach was the establishment of an innovation database. Since 2005 the CAM systematically gathered more than 20.000 product and technological innovations of 40 global car manufacturers and their 100 brands. Sources of information are, amongst others, journals, press releases and on-site surveys on international automobile exhibitions. CAM only accepts identified technological improvements as „innovation“ if they meet three conditions: Innovations must have a perceptible benefit for customers (compared to the status quo), they must be appropriately presented, so that a broad public could take notice of it and they must be available as products, at least as prototypes. If the innovation matches this criteria it is then systematically categorized in seven main technology fields and currently more than 700 innovation types. Finally each innovation is then individually assessed using four different criteria which are its innovation level, originality, maturity level and customer benefit.
Together with our annual patent analysis of the automotive industry this approach allows us to determine the innovation landscape of the industry and to forecast its technological development on a mid- and long-term range perspective. As the database also provides insights in the innovation performance and priorities of each manufacturer it can also be used as a tool for competitive analyses and is therefore licensed by a couple of notable OEMs. 
The other approach focuses on the market and financial performance of the industry competitors. The CAM has established a performance database which contains the sales, financial and other performance figures of each car manufacturer since back in 2002 and is updated quarterly. The financial figures are derived from the official financial statements and include performance indicators like R&D expenditures, EBIT and operative cash flow. The market figures contain information about the global and regional performance (e.g. Europe, NAFTA, BRICs) and are gathered from official statements and reports from manufactures, governmental bodies and advocacy groups. 
Both approaches are used as an empirical foundation for in-depth studies and projects for manufacturers, suppliers as well as governmental and non-governmental organisations. The results of both approaches are also used to provide an annual study about the performance of the industry’s competitors by aligning the innovation, market and financial success of each competitor, resulting in a ranking of the competitors by applying our ‘Automotive Performance Index’ (API) scheme. This approach allows us not only to identify the high, medium and low performers of the competition, but also to provide reliable empirical evidence for the results and statements.

entityDescription: Chris Pharma Works SRL is a Belgium-based pharmacy specialist and research and development company specializing in the convergence of Life Sciences and Neuromorphic Computing. Founded and led by Christophe Ernens, a clinical pharmacist and independent researcher, the company designs disruptive Edge-AI solutions built "from scratch." Our core technology, the BioTensor engine, utilizes biologically inspired Spiking Neural Networks to deliver high-performance, energy-efficient intelligence for mission-critical environments. Our flagship products include Equinox Medical Intelligence, a local AI assistant for clinical safety in pharmacies, and Brain Study, an in silico simulation platform for neurological pathologies and pharmacological research

description:
Mapular provides progressive location data solutions across the globe. We support organisations and businesses to harness their data, extract its value and turn it into an asset.
Using our geospatial skills, we design and build tools to transform underutilised data into an asset. Wherever your data is sourced from - satellites, planes, drones, field collection, IoT, third parties, or through integration with your other business systems - we can help you gain near real-time visibility of your operations. Today that includes AI systems for geospatial data: MCP-based tool servers, geospatial embeddings and data pipelines, and bespoke Esri/ArcGIS development (Esri partner, Nonprofit Specialty).
Orbica UG launched in February 2017 (renamed Mapular UG in 2023) out of a desire that has grown into our purpose: "To enhance billions of lives through the power of geography." We're an innovative and enthusiastic team with an established reputation for solving hard problems. We start with the challenge at hand, devise the best solution, then choose the right tools to ensure your project's success, whether proprietary, open source or hybrid.
Headquartered in Berlin, we have collaborated with many medium and large enterprises across Germany, New Zealand and Australia. Delivered work includes UNESCO's World Heritage monitoring platform, now an Esri case study, and a forest-carbon MRV platform for carbon markets.
We have a highly experienced team, with expertise in remote sensing, Earth observation, geospatial analysis and development, full-stack development, AI and data science, agile and collaborative delivery, and a full suite of business analysis skills. The team's combined knowledge makes Mapular unique in its ability to deliver innovative, complex and specific solutions for tough problems. Thinking outside of the square is what we do every day.
entityDescription: Mapular UG (haftungsbeschraenkt) is a Berlin-based geospatial software engineering SME working at the leading edge of AI for geospatial data. We design and build agentic geospatial systems, including MCP servers in daily production use, alongside full-stack spatial data platforms covering data pipelines, analytics, and web mapping. Delivered work includes a forest-carbon MRV platform, UNESCO's World Heritage monitoring platform, and large-scale field data capture programmes. The team combines senior geospatial engineers, Earth observation expertise, and LLM/AI engineering, moving emerging AI research into delivered production systems. Founded in 2018, Mapular serves clients across Europe and North America.

entityDescription: CARBON PLANET S.R.L. is an innovative startup and certified Benefit Corporation specializing in climate tech and sustainability solutions. The company focuses on the conception, development, implementation, and management of software platforms and shared registries designed to validate, monitor, verify, and store carbon removal and greenhouse gas mitigation certificates. Carbon Planet operates within the voluntary carbon market, helping corporations and public institutions navigate their ecological transition through robust digital frameworks and proprietary certification protocols.
